sections.title: Letter sound ef
paragraphs: The letter name is (эф) /ɛf/. Its main sound is a consonant, which is a sound made when the mouth blocks or narrows the air. You hear it in (фонарь) /fɐˈnarʲ/, which means lantern, streetlight. This letter makes two sounds in Russian words.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: Touch your lower lip to your upper teeth. Blow air through the narrow gap. The sound is voiceless, which is a sound where the voice is off. Your throat does not shake. For the other sound, lift the middle of your tongue toward the roof of your mouth. Keep your lip against your teeth and blow.

sections.title: Spelling rules
paragraphs: This letter sounds hard before hard vowels, consonants, and word-finally. You hear it in (факт) /fakt/. The letter is palatalized before soft-indicating vowels and the soft sign. A palatalized consonant is said with the middle of the tongue raised toward the roof of the mouth. You hear this sound in (фильм) /fʲilʲm/ and in (кофе) /ˈkofʲe/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: You may forget to lift your tongue when a soft vowel follows. The English word coffee has a hard sound at the start. In Russian, lift the middle of your tongue while you bite your lower lip. You must prepare the soft sound early. Do not use your voice, because that turns it into a different sound.
